title: Three-uniform hypergraphs avoiding e edges on e+floor(log₂e)+38 vertices have a polynomial saving below quadratic size
author: Oliver Janzer, Abhishek Methuku, Aleksa Milojević and Benny Sudakov
difficulty_reason: The proof designs eligible hypergraphs with independent good sets that preserve deficiency control under iterative gluing. A counted-copy dichotomy either produces many larger nondegenerate configurations or a sunflower whose core has controlled deficiency. Rainbow bipartite supersaturation starts the iteration, and a degree-one vertex removal argument achieves the exact requested edge count without losing the logarithmic deficiency bound.
